subject: Next steps: Private VPC architecture review for Acme (post-discovery)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-03-30T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: Private VPC architecture review for Acme (post-discovery)

Hi Alice —

Great to meet earlier today, and thanks for walking through Acme's requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned: 

Summary from discovery:
- Use case: low-latency customer-facing LLM features for product search & recommendations.
- Data: customer PII will not be sent; some business metadata may be used. You mentioned data residency in US-East.
- Scale: initial target ~50 QPS with spikes to ~150 for peak windows.
- Timeline: aim to pilot in Q2, production in Q3.

Next step (requested): schedule a technical architecture review (Private/VPC / on-prem options) with our Solutions Architect to walk through network topology, egress/firwall requirements, key management, and deployment model choices.

People I suggest join from our side:
- Marissa Cole (Solutions Architect) — technical lead for Private deployments
- Nikhil Sharma (Account Exec) — commercial/contract coordination

Proposed times (all PDT):
- Wed, Apr 5 — 10:00–11:00
- Thu, Apr 6 — 13:00–14:00 (preferred)
- Fri, Apr 7 — 09:00–10:00

Could you confirm which slot works and who from Acme will attend (I think Bob Lee, your infra lead)? I attached a short pre-reqs doc that helps us prepare (network CIDRs, expected egress, KMS/HSM details). Also attaching a SOC 2 summary per your ask.

Attachments:
- Redwood_Private_VPC_prereqs.pdf (checklist + questions)
- SOC2_summary.pdf

If you prefer, you can pick a slot on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/aditya-vpc-review

Thanks — happy to adjust based on your calendar.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Perfect — confirmed for Thu, Apr 6, 13:00–14:00 PDT. I'll block 60 minutes on everyone's calendar for an architecture + integration deep-dive; if we need more time we can extend.

Agenda (high-level):
- 10–15m: quick discovery recap & success metrics (you + Aditya)
- 30m: Marissa to go through Private/VPC architecture options, network flow, and KMS integration
- 10–15m: integration questions, next steps, and action items

Zoom link & calendar invite: I'll send the invite now — placeholder Zoom link included in the invite.

Prep & asks (from the prereqs doc):
- Network CIDRs and whether Acme will allow outbound to our egress IP ranges (list in the attached PDF).
- Any corporate proxy / egress inspection that might affect gRPC/websocket traffic.
- KMS/HSM provider and whether we need a customer-managed key (CMK).
- Approx QPS and average request size to validate throughput/instance sizing.

Shared prep materials: https://drive.google.com/redwood/acme-vpc-prereqs (includes the attached checklist and an example topology diagram).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-ACME-00123 — Nikhil will follow up on commercial timeline/ procurement.

Attachments included on the invite and thread: Redwood_Private_VPC_prereqs.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf

Let me know if you need us to switch to your Teams link; otherwise we'll use Zoom.

Thanks — see you Thursday.

Aditya
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme-corp.com>, Bob Lee <bob.lee@acme-corp.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@acme-corp.com>

Subject: Re: Next steps: Private VPC architecture review for Acme (post-discovery)

Hi Alice / team —

Thanks for confirming — looking forward to the session. Quick intro: I'm Marissa, Solutions Architect on Redwood's Private deployments. I'll lead the technical portion and want to make sure we use the time efficiently.

Proposed agenda (detailed):
- 10m: quick context & constraints (who's responsible for what on Acme side)
- 25–30m: architecture walk-through (VPC peering / PrivateLink options, NAT/egress, load balancing, autoscaling, KV cache behavior)
- 15m: deployment & security (KMS integration, audit logs, retention, SOC2 practices)
- 10–15m: open Q&A + next steps (runbook, sizing recommendation, timeline)

What would be most helpful to have before the call:
- VPC CIDR blocks and any overlapping ranges (we need these to validate peering options)
- Egress policies / firewall rules that might block outbound traffic to Redwood egress IPs
- KMS provider and whether you require a customer-managed key (Y/N)
- Expected throughput (QPS) and typical request/response sizes

If you can share a simple network diagram (PNG/PDF) ahead of time that would let me tailor the architecture review to your environment. I've attached an example topology diagram stub in the calendar invite.

I'll send the calendar invite from my account with a Zoom link and a short agenda note. If you prefer Teams, we'll use that instead — Aditya, please use Acme's Teams link if that's their standard.

Looking forward to it —
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
